successBody: Your request has been received. We'll be in touch soon to find a time to talk. Taking this step takes courage — we're glad you're here.
crisisIntro: This website isn't a crisis service and messages aren't monitored around the clock. If you're in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, please use one of these now:
intro: Send a note and Becky will be in touch to set a time to talk. You don't need the right words, and you don't need to have it figured out — reaching out is enough.
placeholderMessage: A sentence or two about what brings you here is plenty.
metaDescription: Reach out to Becky for an unhurried first conversation. Please leave private health details out of this form — you'll have somewhere safer to share them.
successCrisisNote: If you're in crisis, please call or text 988 (U.S. Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or dial 911. This website is not a crisis service.
privacyNote: FOR YOUR PRIVACY: please do NOT include sensitive health details or medical history in this form. We'll gather anything we need securely when we connect.
optionalIntro: All of these can be skipped — they just help Becky prepare before you speak.
